why: Car washes are membership-based with fast tickets, subscription tiers and quick turnaround. The key is the fast lane, membership management and cash-flow predictability.
operator: The car wash owner manages membership tiers, fast ticket sales and queue management. Their day is member check-ins, subscription renewals and cash reconciliation.
entities: CarWash (id, nameAr, nameEn, branchId, address, phone, currency, taxRegistration, openingHours)
MembershipTier (id, washId, nameAr, nameEn, pricePiasters, durationDays, washCount, isActive, features)
Member (id, washId, name, phone, membershipTierId, status, joinDate, expiryDate, visitsThisPeriod, washesThisPeriod)
Ticket (id, washId, memberId, phone, type (membership/ticket/pay-per-wash), amountPiasters, status, generatedAt, usedAt)
Queue (id, washId, ticketId, position, status (waiting/being-served/done), updatedAt)
CashRecord (id, date, openingPiasters, countedPiasters, variancePiasters, notes)
batches: No : car wash carries no stock or expiry
expiry: Not applicable. Memberships have duration and wash count, tickets have status
special: The core structures are the membership tier with wash count and duration, the ticket (membership/ticket/pay-per-wash) and the queue position. Fast turnaround and cash-flow predictability are the key metrics.
screens: Member check-in: scan member phone or ticket, view membership status, increment washesThisPeriod, position in queue
Membership management: add tier, set price, duration, wash count, features (fast lane, free vacuum, etc.), activate/deactivate
Ticket generation: create ticket (membership/ticket/pay-per-wash), record amount, set status (active/used)
Queue management: view waiting tickets, position, move to being-served, mark done
Cash reconciliation: daily opening vs counted, variance, notes, print Z-report
Membership overview: all members, active tiers, renewal upcoming, visits per period
Staff shift: clock in/out, customer load per hour, notes
roles: Owner: everything : memberships, tickets, queue, cash, reports, billing
Attendant: member check-in, ticket generation, queue management, cash recording
Manager: membership tiers, pricing, attendant scheduling, reports
reports: Daily revenue: total washes, membership revenue, ticket sales, cash variance
Membership growth: new members per period, renewals, churn per period
Wash frequency per member: visits per period, average visits per member
Queue efficiency: average wait time, tickets per hour, peak hours
Membership tier performance: which tiers sell best, wash count per tier
integrations: Esc/POS thermal printer for tickets and Z-report
WhatsApp deep link for membership renewal notices and membership reactivation
onboarding: Wash basics: name, branch, address, phone, currency, working hours
Membership tiers: the initial tiers (basic, premium, premium-plus) with price, duration and wash count
Initial members: the first member records with tier assignment
Staff: add the initial team with their role templates
First week plan: set up first membership tier, first member, first ticket
seed: No sector-specific seed data. The engine provides the membership tier and role templates.

tasks.title: Add membership tier manager
tasks.brief: Build the tier screen: add tier, set price, duration, wash count, features, activate/deactivate. Done when the tier is saved and appears in the member check-in screen.
tasks.done: When membership tier manager works and tiers appear in check-in

tasks.title: Add member check-in with queue position
tasks.brief: Build the check-in screen: scan member phone or ticket, view membership status, increment washesThisPeriod, position in queue. Done when check-in saves and queue position updates correctly.
tasks.done: When member check-in works end-to-end with queue position

tasks.title: Add ticket generation (membership/ticket/pay-per-wash)
tasks.brief: Build the ticket screen: create ticket type, record amount, set status (active/used). Done when the ticket is saved and status updates correctly.
tasks.done: When ticket generation works end-to-end with status tracking

tasks.title: Add queue management (waiting/being-served/done)
tasks.brief: Build the queue screen: view waiting tickets, position, move to being-served, mark done. Done when the queue updates positions and status correctly.
tasks.done: When queue management works end-to-end with position and status updates

tasks.title: Add daily cash reconciliation Z-report
tasks.brief: Build the Z-report screen: opening vs counted, variance, notes, print. Done when the report computes from the day's cash record and prints correctly.
tasks.done: When Z-report works end-to-end and prints correctly

tasks.title: Add membership growth report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing new members per period, renewals, churn. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When membership growth report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add wash frequency per member report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing visits per period per member and average visits per member. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When wash frequency report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add queue efficiency report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing average wait time, tickets per hour, peak hours. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When queue efficiency report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add membership tier performance report
tasks.brief: Build the report showing which tiers sell best, wash count per tier. Done when the report computes from Firestore and displays correct figures.
tasks.done: When membership tier performance report computes correctly from live data

tasks.title: Add onboarding flow for initial car wash setup
tasks.brief: Build the onboarding flow: wash basics, initial membership tiers, first members, staff addition. Done when the flow completes and the wash appears with all defaults.
tasks.done: When onboarding flow works end-to-end and wash is created

risks: Encryption key loss makes member and cash records unrecoverable
WhatsApp template rejection if not approved by Meta
Membership subscriptions without clear duration and wash count can violate consumer protection law
Cash variance without audit trail can lead to disputes
